$comment: Slot -> screenshot id for scripts/web-compose.py. Screens are looked up in art/web/screens/{dark,light}/ first, then in the CI folders below (Dark falls back to Light). 'swapTo' names the Pro screen that should replace today's stand-in once CI photographs it: change 'screen' to that id and re-run the script.
